question: With which of the following sports Prasanta Dora associated, who passed away at the age of 44 in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Football.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Prasanta Dora** was** a Former Indian and Mohun Bagan, East Bengal goalkeeper who passed away in January 2021**.
 
• He made his debut in **1999 against Thailand in the Olympic qualifiers.**
 
• Prasanta also represented **Bengal in the Santosh Trophy**. After turning out for clubs like **Tollygunge Agragami and Calcutta Port Trust, the big break came in 1999 when he joined East Bengal.**
